title: St. Ivory
meta_description: Find the perfect Rosemary Beach, FL vacation rental at “St. Ivory”, a luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home house offers a Private Pool, Outdoor Entertainment Area, Elevator & 6 Bikes. Book your stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Rare, Spacious Private Lot - Private Heated Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day from October 1-May 1) - Entertain Outdoors with Outdoor Grill - Elevator - Open Floor Plan with Chef’s Kitchen - Sonos Home Sound System - Observation Sunset Tower with Gulf Views - 6 Adult Bikes Included for Exploring Neighborhood Paths - In addition to being a part of a Private Beach Access Community, St Ivory guests have access to Rosemary Beach’s 4 Community Pools – 3 Outdoor and 1 Indoor. A luxurious escape awaits you in this newer Rosemary Beach home. St. Ivory is a custom-designed 5 Bedroom, 5.5 bath tower home. Boasting an open floor plan designed for bringing together family and friends. Ample on-property parking through the private gate welcome guests into the outdoor courtyard with a heated pool, outdoor living room and fireplace and built-in grill. Step inside through any of the four French doors and discover an open-floor plan ideal for entertaining with a living room, dining area and gourmet chef's kitchen featuring Thermador appliances, two dishwashers, an expansive walk-in pantry, and laundry room. The first floor includes an oversized king suite with fireplace and French doors that open to the courtyard. As you adventure to the second and third floors, the elevator will help make moving into your home-away-from home even easier. The second floor hosts a large media space at the top of the stairs, two king suites, a bunk room with two twin-over-full bunkbeds, and an additional laundry. All three bedrooms provide attached bathrooms and feature relaxing balconies. The third floor hosts a lounge area with wet bar and 5th bedroom. This third-floor king en suite room features a surprising hide-away loft with four twin beds. Take the spiral staircase to the top of the home and enjoy private sunset viewing from the observation tower featuring 360 degrees views of the Gulf of Mexico and Rosemary Beach. First Floor King Bed w/ Shower and Tub separate Second Floor Bunk Room Consisting of Two Twins and Two Full Beds w/ Shower tub combo King Bed w/ Shower Only King Bed w/ Shower Only Third Floor King bed w/ Shower Only Four Twin Beds w/ Shared Bath **During peak season, all of our properties are rented with a 7-night minimum from Saturday to Saturday.**
